# Frozen Wave 2 evidence

The three independent scenario reports precede observation and are retained
byte-for-byte. `cases.json` preserves task text, symbols, source hashes and all
62/49/56 obligations; architecture shorthand was normalized to canonical route
IDs before scoring. The uniform bounded 128K/64K budget is a resource profile,
not a reduction in expected evidence. `sources.json` maps 497 production-loader
admitted files to SHA256-named flat blobs. No service secret paths were captured.

Gold verifies real R1 → Prepare → Expand, independent source/test recall,
precision, deterministic Prepare digests, foreign owner/layer exclusion, dirty
snapshot provenance and explicit unresolved status. All27 tests may pass while
Profile v2 remains PARTIAL: test success verifies safe behavior including retained
owner review and the two explicitly diagnosed T08 contract-adapter misses. It does
not assert that those requirements have been satisfied or certify service runtime.
